description: 인천항만공사_인천항 연안여객터미널 여객정보 내역 조회 서비스 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천항만공사. endRow, skipRow, pageNo, 인증키 등이 있으며, 응답 결과에는 입항구분, 여객 수, 선박명, 업체명, 국가코드 및 이름, 선석코드, 부두명, 항구명 등 다양한 항만. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 인천항만공사. Its tags are 연안여객터미널, 여객정보, 인천항 여객터미널, 승객 수, 입항정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
